free_tier.stated: Free MongoDB Atlas credits and Voyage AI tokens across four tiers: Inspire for bootstrapped startups, Grow for early-funded, Innovate for rising VC-backed, and Scale for rapidly scaling. Base-tier eligibility: less than 7 years old, Series A or earlier, building a single software-based product, not previously accepted, with an active company website and LinkedIn profile.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Atlas credits at the small-cluster scale are worth tens of dollars a month, so even the top tier is a small absolute benefit beside the compute credits in this class. It composes with a Databricks application, since the two programs overlap on Neon.

limits.value: The company-shaped application fails first, and the amount is undisclosed, so even a successful applicant cannot size the benefit before committing to the platform.
